description: web autopilot run of stage 1 (?skip=jam&auto=1): 4800 ticks of Traffic.update + every outside-update Traffic call (honk, rageHorn, miniHit, smash, release, …); per-tick state hash, full state every 60 ticks
dt_model: WEB USES VARIABLE dt: main.js frame(now) → step(min(0.05, (now-last)/1000)) per requestAnimationFrame (or fixed 1/30 x N with ?ff=N). This recording drove rAF from virtual time at 120 Hz (frame step 1000/120 ms), so dt ≈ 1/120 but NOT bit-constant: use in.dt of each tick (exact).

fields.events[].player: player state at call time (honk/rageHorn read it)
fields.in.player: s x w len lane v mode
fields.in.sinLf: Math.sin(in.time*0.42 + lane*1.9) for lane 0..4 as computed by the web (traffic.js:406)
fields.in.villains: s baseS x w len v vNominal alive

hash: out.h = first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over f64le(s[0..N-1]) | f64le(v[0..N-1]) | f64le(x[0..N-1]) | f64le(opp_s[0..M-1]) | u8(lane[0..N-1]) | u32le(obstacles), cars in car_ids order, x = actual lateral position
math: Only one transcendental feeds the sim state: the packed-lane factor sin(t*0.42 + lane*1.9) (traffic.js:406). libm sin is NOT bit-identical across JS engines/libms: in a sample of 13175 distinct sin args (ticks 500-586 of traffic_ticks_stage1), Chromium 141 Math.sin and Node 22 Math.sin differed in the last ulp on 96, while glibc 2.39 sin() matched Chromium on 13174 (so C++ std::sin is close but not guaranteed; iOS/Android libms are untested). A bit-exact replay must use in.sinLf for those calls (the Node replay does). Math.pow(x, 2) in the IDM equals x*x; sqrt is exact; atan2 only feeds the visual yaw.
render: renderer.render replaced by the scene/camera matrix updates it performs (no drawing; same logic inputs)
replay: Spawn stage 1 (spawn_stage1.json). Then for each tick i: (1) apply events with tick == i in order: set the player fields from event.player, call Traffic[m](...args) with "$player" = the player object, {$car:id} / {$obs:id} / {$villain:k} = those objects, {$undef:true} = undefined; it must draw exactly event.rng and return event.ret; (2) if in.obstacleIds is present, drop obstacles not in it (removed directly by main.js); (3) set player/villains/extras fields from in.*, call Traffic.update(in.dt, {time: in.time, phase, allowEvents, focusS, player, villains, extras}) with sin(t*0.42+lane*1.9) taken from in.sinLf; it must draw exactly out.rng ([tag, u32]), leave out.obstacles obstacles, and hash to out.h; on keyframes cars (car_ids order) must equal out.s / out.v / out.lane, x = out.x[id] ?? laneX(lane), opp[k].s = out.opp_s[k]. Player/villain objects keep identity across ticks. The Node replay of this file passes (tools/export-content.mjs).
